results.description:
# Teacher Salary Australia 2026: How Much Teachers Get Paid
## How much do full-time teachers get paid in each state?
### Western Australia
[Teacher salary in WA](https://www.education.wa.edu.au/teacher-salaries) starts at $88,178 for a graduate on level 2.1, with an increment each year of satisfactory service up to $127,737 at level 2.9.
